![Bildschirmfoto 2024-11-08 um 12.09.13.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/worldmappin/244yEy5qSCXtUvcrjRizV4nUGFzqkmCawfYRq6fAbpwAnd7Gj8Hz8BJRAVYjA9sBp1cDJ.png)
[Léelo en **español** aquí](#spanish)
Many of you know him for a long time. @ybanezkim26 has been part of this project even before Worldmappin. He is a beloved and important member of our curation team and is currently in a very difficult situation. ## What happened? Two days ago we got the message, that Kim is currently at the hospital in the Philippines, as his sister was taken there with kidney nephritis. She is currently at the intensive care unit as her heart has been damaged due to the excess water, so she's being monitored for that. The insurance cover has already been fully used, so from now on it's all private costs. This is the invoice for only two days, so you have proof of verity and an idea of the costs that will come for Kim and his family... in Dollars the bill currently running is already at $4500. ![IMG_20241108_151215-1.webp](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/worldmappin/Ep1ZnBtkMUfk6ucTJAUuPpeDkvnfyGjbgvtddRK2CHQqJowjHWZumvYLWxAh2FworHe.webp) As head of the family, he is currently responsible for everything going on with his sister. As the "expert" there, he is taking care of everything, like processing her papers, choosing her specialists, talking to a lot of people, about her insurance, her company, everything. So you can imagine that he is pretty stressed and does not leave her side, basically camping at the hospital. At the same time, he still wants to do some curation to distract himself in between the hours to not let down the community. ![IMG_20241107_220314.webp](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/worldmappin/EokdCKFWzhckvFkbV3BdHiWkqrnZ3SuT5vrg12eG3mHFMSxuAur4sFVjnUhRjKswujF.webp) Right now he is waiting for her to be transferred to the normal ward, but still waiting for clearance from her cardiologist and pulmonologist. So far, her heart is stable but slow to pump blood. She has a lung infection so also waiting for her pulmonologist. And they'll wait for another 5 to 7 days for her kidney biopsy to determine the real cause of her nephritis. When we, @lizanomadsoul and @detlev heard about his situation it was 100% clear for us to give him a hand right away. We used part of the funds our curation team and the account generated by all the great work this team is doing - to help a friend in need. ![Bildschirmfoto 2024-11-08 um 12.25.29.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/worldmappin/23tv48BgnjYMaWY7qVuG9wNZC1tBZNkZDW93jJxU47vhjiAcqYMoCa6a4S4Fv1KUpXXKN.png) ## What you can do Hive has proven so many times that we are strong as a community helping each other especially when it comes to difficult situations like that, so we decided to support him as a team and also ask the community for some support as well. So if you want to help him as well - Upvote this post, as it will go 100% to his account - reblog this post for more visibility - feel free to transfer him some HBD /Hive - and/or send good thoughts and prayers to whatever you believe in is Any help is much appreciated <3 @ybanezkim26 for sure will give full transparency about the received help and keep you updated. ---
**Español** # Apoyemos a nuestro querido miembro del equipo @ybanezkim26 Muchos de ustedes lo conocen desde hace mucho tiempo. @ybanezkim26 ha formado parte de este proyecto incluso antes de Worldmappin. Es un miembro muy querido e importante de nuestro equipo de curación y actualmente se encuentra en una situación muy difícil. ## ¿Qué ha pasado? Hace dos días recibimos el mensaje de que Kim se encuentra actualmente en el hospital en Filipinas, ya que su hermana fue llevada allí con nefritis renal. Está en la unidad de cuidados intensivos porque el exceso de agua ha afectado a su corazón, así que la están monitorizando. La cobertura del seguro ya se ha utilizado en su totalidad, así que a partir de ahora todo son gastos privados. Esta es la factura de sólo dos días, para que tengáis una prueba de veracidad y una idea de los costes que supondrá para Kim y su familia... en dólares la factura actual ya asciende a 4500 dólares. ![IMG_20241108_151215-1.webp](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/worldmappin/Ep1ZnBtkMUfk6ucTJAUuPpeDkvnfyGjbgvtddRK2CHQqJowjHWZumvYLWxAh2FworHe.webp) Como cabeza de familia, actualmente es el responsable de todo lo relacionado con su hermana. Como «experto» que es, se ocupa de todo, como tramitar sus papeles, elegir a sus especialistas, hablar con un montón de gente, sobre su seguro, su compañía, todo. Así que puedes imaginarte que está bastante estresado y no se separa de ella, básicamente acampando en el hospital. Al mismo tiempo, sigue queriendo hacer algo de curación para distraerse entre horas y no defraudar a la comunidad. ![IMG_20241107_220314.webp](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/worldmappin/EokdCKFWzhckvFkbV3BdHiWkqrnZ3SuT5vrg12eG3mHFMSxuAur4sFVjnUhRjKswujF.webp) Ahora mismo está esperando a que la trasladen a una sala ordinaria, pero sigue esperando el visto bueno de su cardiólogo y neumólogo. De momento, su corazón está estable, pero bombea sangre con lentitud. Tiene una infección pulmonar, así que también está esperando por su neumólogo. Y esperarán otros 5 a 7 días para su biopsia renal para determinar la causa real de su nefritis. Cuando nosotros, @lizanomadsoul y @detlev nos enteramos de su situación tuvimos 100% claro que debíamos echarle una mano de inmediato. Utilizamos parte de los fondos de nuestro equipo de curación y lo generado por la cuenta, gracias al gran trabajo que está haciendo este equipo, para ayudar a un amigo necesitado. ![Bildschirmfoto 2024-11-08 um 12.25.29.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/worldmappin/23tv48BgnjYMaWY7qVuG9wNZC1tBZNkZDW93jJxU47vhjiAcqYMoCa6a4S4Fv1KUpXXKN.png) ## Qué puedes hacer tú Hive ha demostrado muchas veces que somos una comunidad fuerte que se ayuda mutuamente, sobre todo cuando se trata de situaciones difíciles como esta, así que hemos decidido apoyarle como equipo y también pedir ayuda a la comunidad. Así que si quieres ayudarle también - Vota este post, ya que irá 100% a su cuenta - rebloguea este post para darle más visibilidad - siéntete libre de transferirle algo de HBD /Hive - y / o enviar buenos pensamientos y oraciones a quien sea en que creas Cualquier ayuda es muy apreciada <3 @ybanezkim26 seguro que dará total transparencia sobre la ayuda recibida y les mantendrá informados.

content.body:
So there's been these terrible floods on Valencia because of the #DANA making the Turia river to overflow, devastating shops and particular homes alike. Due the absurd and inefficient levels of bureaucracy here, authorities were unable neither to warn the people nor help in a significant way. Many lives have been lost in the way, and the survivors have lost everything.

This only shows that, in the current context, no power will save Valencia and we're left alone with our own means. Realizing this, most people from the Valencian Web3 scene where I am included have started to organize ourselves to give support to those in need. My friend [IshtarSpring](https://bio.link/ishtar_spring) created this NFT collection whose funds will help the #DANA victims.


![SolsElPoble.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/s1vh/EoGyuEeMAmVxZabXDvb5aJk1pSEeGzCvUKbtT6h9BsU9nsaTRD1DAzghLDjJ7rYXY8p.png)
👉 Mint yours [here](https://www.frensdegens.com/sols-el-poble/) !

As for me, I was lucky enough to live in an unaffected area. I only had to endure a few blackouts and power cuts, but my equipment is safe. So I'm working with a colleague on a PFP collection that will add to the humanitarian aid already being deployed in the disaster area.

More news to come soon. If you are an artist and want to help, please contact me here or through any of my social media. Thanks in advance.

Peace and stay safe.
